section: 5/6/2026Amended by Chapter 324, 2026 General Session2026Definitions.As used in this part:"Emergency services" means:emergency medical services as defined in Section 53-2d-101;fire protection services; ora combination of emergency medical services, as defined in Section 53-2d-101, and fire protection services."Emergency services tax" means the sales and use tax authorized under Section 59-12-2402."Governing body" means:for a county, city, or town, the legislative body of the county, city, or town; orfor a special service district:the legislative body of the county, city, or town that established the special service district, if no administrative control board has been created under Section 17D-1-301; orthe administrative control board of the special service district, if an administrative control board has been created under Section 17D-1-301."Qualifying political subdivision" means:a specified county;a special service district established under Title 17D, Chapter 1, Special Service District Act, to provide emergency services within a specified county; ora city or town that:is located:within a specified county; andoutside the boundaries of a special service district described in Subsection (4)(b); andprovides, or contracts with a special service district described in Subsection (4)(b) to receive, emergency services within the city or town."Specified county" means a county of the second or third class, as classified in Section 17-60-104, that contains:a national park and two or more state parks within or partially within the county's boundaries; anda municipality with a population of 95,000 or more.
